name: otto-qa-runner
description: AdsPower QA automation tool for testing product journeys on Otto.de using existing browser profiles

scripts.generate-certs: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -subj '/CN=localhost' -keyout certs/key.pem -out certs/cert.pem -days 365
scripts.validate:all: npm run validate && node --check companion/server.cjs && node --check tests/optional-position.cjs
